text:
Samira: Quick ping — final onsite for ML Infra candidate is Mon 2025-06-23 15:00 PT. Need scribe + rubric lead.
Priya: I can scribe, free then.
Dan: I can take rubric lead. Which rubric template are we using?
Samira: Use `eng_interview_v3` (infra + systems). High level: system design 50%, tradeoffs 30%, communication/culture 20%.
Elena: Quick Q — do we want them to whiteboard or bring a short doc? I'm leaning interactive whiteboard + 10 min walkthrough.
Priya: OK — I'll put that in the calendar invite and add a short prompt in the invite: "Come prepared for an interactive system design; bring notes if helpful."
interview-bot: Reminder: to add scribe to calendar run: `/invite @Priya` and to set debrief channel add `#hiring-debriefs`.
Samira: Also, capture scoring anchors in the debrief: 1 = misses core concepts, 3 = solid with tradeoffs, 5 = exceptional and pragmatic. Dan — can you paste anchors + 2 short examples before EOD?
Dan: Yep — I'll post anchors + two example answers (one borderline, one strong) in the debrief thread by 5pm.
Samira: Awesome, thanks both :thumbsup: Priya — please enable meeting recording and ensure scribe has access to the transcript.
Priya: Got it. I'll also add a 10-min buffer in the invite for post-interview debrief.
Samira: Perfect. I'll update candidate email to include format and timing.
Elena: Thanks — tagging for visibility @everyone in case backups needed.
Samira: If anyone wants to swap roles, ping here. Otherwise we're set.
